notes.title: 🚢 Update: Fixes, Improvements & What’s Next
notes.notes:
Hey Castaways!
Over the last weeks you’ve been sending us tons of valuable feedback – and today many of those fixes have landed in 30 Days on Ship! This update focuses on the most requested improvements that will make survival on board smoother, clearer, and more immersive.


[hr][/hr]

✅ What’s Fixed & Improved
Here’s a quick rundown of the changes that made it in:

⚙️ Optimization & Comfort – implemented TSR & DLSS for upscaling, framegen and improved anti-aliasing. No more ghosting during quick camera moves.

📘 Early Game Path (Tutorial) – clearer first steps and survival guidance.

🌐 Multiplayer – improved flow for hosting/joining games; less confusion, smoother co-op.

💾 Save System – UI updated so it’s clear how to save and load progress.

📖 Mission Log – first version added to help track objectives.

🖥️ UI Improvements – cleaner, more intuitive interface across the board.

🎵 Sounds – missing effects filled in; ambience and interactions now feel more alive.

🕹️ Animations – polishing transitions and fixing reported glitches.

🎮 Controller Support – better mapping and UI navigation for gamepads.


[hr][/hr]

🔮 What’s Next
With these fixes in place, we’re moving on to AI improvements – one of the most requested features.
If all goes well, we’re planning another update to the demo later this month, bringing even more of your top suggestions into the game.


[hr][/hr]


Thank you for playing, testing, and sending us your thoughts. Every report helps us make 30 Days on Ship a better survival experience. Keep the feedback coming – and stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: Playtest Update And On the Horizon: Full Version in the Works
notes.notes:
Hey Castaways!
It’s time for a big update — and a look at what’s ahead.
We’ve just rolled out a new content patch for the playtest, and at the same time, we’re officially shifting gears into full production of the complete version of 30 Days on Ship. Let’s dive into both.

👉 We assumed we’re not far from opening up a public demo, but we want to make sure it’s solid and meaningful when it lands.
[hr][/hr][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/d58dda9a7610e17730bb0a7870631437c6022679.gif"]🔄 Playtest Update: Now With Swimming and... Something Below
Last week, we sent out 50,000 new invites to the playtest — bringing the total number of participants to over 100,000 players and we want more!
This is a huge milestone for us. Thanks to your feedback, bug reports, and hardware testing, the game is now running more stable than ever, with consistent performance across most systems.

To celebrate that progress (and to test new mechanics in action), we’ve added a small but meaningful update to the current build:

🌊 Swimming is now available
You can finally get off the ship and into the water. Exploring the flooded surroundings opens up new tactical options — and new dangers.

🦈 Meet your first aquatic enemy: the Shark
It’s fast. It’s deadly. And it’s always lurking nearby. Consider this your first lesson in underwater survival.

📦 Sunken container: risk vs reward
We’ve placed a single locked container underwater. It might hold something useful — if you can get to it and back without becoming dinner.

This is just a taste of what underwater exploration will feel like in the full version — eerie, resourceful, and filled with tension.
[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/1d034d86cfacfa713cd23d302e0d4be65161dbf9.gif"]
🚧 Full Version: Production Is Underway
With the playtest running well, our focus has now fully shifted to building out the complete version of the game. That means deeper systems, broader exploration, and more threats and stories to uncover.

Here’s what we’re actively working on:

🚗 Vehicles
Yep. Drivable vehicles are coming. Whether it’s hauling loot across long distances, reaching off-ship locations, or just speeding through hostile zones — vehicles will become a vital part of survival.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/092298824f8153bf6dc669b548f821b8426b455e.gif"]

🧟 New Enemies & AI Behavior
We’re designing more enemy types with varied behaviors — patrols, ambushes, smart reactions. Expect to be surprised, challenged, and maybe even hunted.

🌊 Marine Life
The ocean is about to come alive. Some creatures might help you. Most… probably won’t. Underwater exploration will get more intense — and more rewarding.

🏝️ More Islands & Off-Ship Expeditions
The wreck isn’t the only thing left in the world. We’re working on distant islands and isolated points of interest that reward players willing to take the risk — and have the tools to return.

🔧 Crafting, Upgrades, and Base Systems
We’re expanding the core survival loop with deeper crafting, workbench upgrades, structural improvements, and more flexible ways to build and defend your base.

📖 Narrative & Worldbuilding
Expect more story threads, notes, recordings, and environmental storytelling as we flesh out the mystery of what happened — and what’s still out there.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/cf7a4f84b58db46674812d60a26f8b88f4c8909c.gif"]
[hr][/hr]
Thank you again to everyone who joined the playtest, gave feedback, or added 30 Days on Ship to their wishlist. Your support genuinely helps shape the future of the game.

We’ll be back soon with more updates, including a sneak peek at upcoming features. Until then…

Stay dry. Or don’t. 🦈

📌 Wishlist 30 Days on Ship on Steam

notes.title: Development Update! – CO-OP, Combat, Crafting and more....
notes.notes:
Hey, Castaways!🌊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/ff94e2a43d951418426cad00cd7aa0f9f0315b2f.png

We’ve got some exciting news for you!🎉 Thanks to your suggestions and continuous support, we’re thrilled to announce several major updates coming to 30 Days on Ship soon. Let’s dive in!🏊‍♂️

CO-OP Mode - Your Requests Have Been Heard!⚓
You asked for more interaction, and we listened! We’re excited to share that 30 Days on Ship will feature 4-player co-op mode. Team up with up to three other players, manage your resources, and work as a crew to survive the full 30-day journey. Cooperation will be crucial—every task, from repairing the ship to rationing supplies, will require careful planning and teamwork.
[previewyoutube=d1MlZHud84w;full][/previewyoutube]

We're still fine-tuning the co-op experience to ensure it’s both engaging and immersive, so stay tuned for more updates as we move forward with development!

Expanded Crafting – More Depth, More Possibilities 🛠️
We're refining and expanding the crafting system to make it more intuitive and rewarding. New tools, items, and survival gear will give you more options to adapt to the challenges at sea. We're focusing on balancing and polishing the mechanics to ensure crafting feels both engaging and essential to your journey.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/25a12a309e13da64cc1190018466989ac1c2bcf3.gif

Enhanced Combat – New Challenges Await ⚔️
Survival at sea isn’t just about managing resources—it’s also about facing the dangers that lurk beyond the waves. We’ve been refining the combat system to make encounters more dynamic and engaging. From defending against pirate attacks to fending off wildlife, every fight will require strategy and skill. Watch out for your friends - friendly fire is on!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883204/6a8022467bb23d8da7163011372403c6f6696cec.gif

Playtests in February - Join Us!📝🎮
Last but not least - playtests are coming this February! 📅 This is your chance to experience the new features firsthand and share your feedback with us.💬 Keep an eye on our social media channels and sign up for the playtests to be among the first survivors to test them out!🚀

That’s all for now! Thank you for your continued support - we can’t wait for you to try these new features. Stay tuned for more updates!🧭

See you on board!
